weapon.description: Where weapon data lives and how a new weapon gets registered.
weapon.howTo: Add an entry to the WEAPONS array in src/data/entities/combat.ts, typed as Weapon (src/data/entities/types.ts). Referenced by hero/boss combat code and bossFight mode.

boss.description: Where boss data lives and how a new boss gets registered.
boss.howTo: Add an entry to the BOSSES array in src/data/entities/bosses.ts, typed as BossConfig. Reference the boss's id from a chapter's `bossFight` beat (bossId field).

mode.description: Where minigame modes are registered (the B3/H2 mode registry).
mode.howTo: Run `npm run agent:scaffold-mode -- <modeId>` (H2) to copy _template/, register it, and stub the CLAUDE.md doc row automatically. Manual recipe: docs/ADDING_A_MINIGAME.md.

chapter.description: Where chapters are registered and what a chapter config looks like.
chapter.howTo: Copy an existing chapter file in src/data/chapters/, configure map/beats, and append it to the CHAPTERS list in src/data/chapters/index.ts. Validate with `npm run agent:validate-chapter -- <id>` (H1).
